title: Light Roasted Venezuelan Chicken Bowl
description: A high protein dish featuring roasted chicken, oyster sauce, and score fat, served in a Korean brass bowl, this Light Roasted Venezuelan Chicken Bowl is a delicious and healthy option for dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together oyster sauce, score fat, olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Place the chicken breast in a large bowl and brush the oyster sauce mixture evenly over both sides of the chicken.
Let the chicken marinate for 10 minutes.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil and roast in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the chicken into thin strips.
Serve the chicken in a Korean brass bowl.
